thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — launching a new pricing construct today: Sustained Usage Tiers. :tada:

maria: TL;DR: for customers with steady, predictable hosted API traffic we'll auto-apply a tiered discount that grows with sustained monthly usage. This is a billing-side change (not a rate-limit change). Effective for invoices with a period starting 2026-05-01. Internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/sustained-usage (read-only link).

kevin: Nice. Does this affect startup free credits / promo credits? :question:

maria: Good q — promo/free credits are unchanged. Sustained tiers apply after credits are consumed. If a customer still has promo credit balance, they'll see the tiered discount reflected on the invoice but final charge uses credits first.

eric: Will this change how we route requests or autoscaling thresholds?

maria: No. This is purely pricing smoothing + invoice line items. No infra or routing changes. If you see telemetry that looks off after May 1, ping eng-telemetry and finance.

billing-bot: Sample invoice line item preview:
```
2026-05-01 to 2026-05-31 — Hosted API token usage: 3,200,000 tokens
Sustained Usage Tier (Level 2) discount: -7.5% applied to base token charges
Final charge after credits and discounts: $X.XX
```

sam: Any guidance for AEs talking to enterprise customers who have committed capacity?

maria: For Dedicated/Committed contracts nothing changes unless the contract explicitly references hosted tiering. For enterprise with hosted + committed mix, use this script: "We're introducing a sustained-usage discount for hosted usage only; your committed capacity pricing and SLAs are unaffected." I'll paste a short canned blurb in the doc and add a slide for customer calls.

finance-lead: We'll run a retroactive audit for last-month invoices that are still unsettled, and finance will apply one-off credits if needed. Ops: please expect a handful of support tickets the first week.

kevin: Can we get a short FAQ to drop into support macros?

maria: Yes — created the FAQ section in the doc and added a Support Macro sample. Copy/paste allowed: "Sustained Usage Tiers provide incremental discounts for steady monthly hosted usage; credits apply first; effective invoice period 2026-05-01. For billing questions, email billing@redwood.ai."

sam: Thanks — I'll loop in customer success for the marquee accounts. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks team. If anyone sees edge cases (multi-account billing, reseller pass-through, etc.) add them to the tracker in the doc and tag me.

kevin: tagging #support and #sales FYI. :eyes:
